title: Ambani magic captivates India once more with blockbuster deal
summary: Jio Platforms Ltd. recorded India's largest IPO, raising $3.1 billion and experiencing a 27% rise in shares. title: Securities Appellate Tribunal quashes Rs 1.49 crore penalty on Ventura Securities by MCX

As a result, the tribunal has ordered MCX to reimburse the fine, including an additional ₹ 1 lakh for the brokerage's legal expenses.

summary: The listing of Jio Platforms has significantly impacted India's corporate rankings, with Reliance Industries regaining the top position.
